initialize_VideomtConfig: initialize a VideomtConfig instance inheriting from EomtConfig for video transformer settings
build_VideomtForUniversalSegmentation: build a VideomtForUniversalSegmentation model from a VideomtConfig for universal video segmentation
run_Videomt_forward: run the forward pass of VideomtForUniversalSegmentation with 5D video tensor inputs
create_VideomtEmbeddings: create VideomtEmbeddings with patch embeddings, mask tokens, and positional encodings for video frames
get_Videomt_segmentation_output: get VideomtForUniversalSegmentationOutput containing class queries, mask queries, and hidden states
